permissions.create: Write letters to the time capsule
permissions.community: Start and manage the community time capsule

settings.nav: Show a Time Capsule link in the forum sidebar
settings.tag_help: A member can ask for their letter to start a discussion when it opens. With tags on, choose the tag those discussions go in, or the option is hidden.
settings.max_years: Furthest a letter can be sealed, in years
settings.founded_help: Used for the "forum's birthday" open date. It starts as the first member's join date; change it if the forum is older than that.
settings.backup_help: Letters and their photos are encrypted, so nobody can read a sealed letter by looking in the database. The key is in storage/time-capsule/key, next to the encrypted photos in storage/time-capsule/photos. Back up that folder with your database: without the key, sealed letters can never be opened. Letters open on the scheduler, so make sure Flarum's scheduler is running (the dashboard says so if it isn't).

page.title: Time Capsule
page.intro: Write a letter to the future. It's sealed until the day you choose: nobody can read it before then, not even the admins.
page.guest: Log in to write a letter and to read the ones that have opened.
page.no_permission: You don't have permission to see the time capsule.
page.log_in_to_write: Log in to write a letter
page.sealed_empty: No sealed letters yet. Write one to your future self: what you hope for, what you're working on, a photo of today.
page.recent_empty: No one has shared an opened letter yet.
